Closed as a duplicate of **#9471** — same residual, same fix, filed minutes apart. Both descriptions stay readable; #9471 is the one to work.

**The duplicate is the PM's fault, and worth recording as such.** PR #9470's body named this residual and said it was worth a follow-up card. I read that, verified `RUNNER.md:55` still carries the unconditional sentence on `main`, and filed #9471 — **while the runner that had just told me about it was still running and about to file it itself**. The protocol warns that two agents auditing adjacent code in the same hour produce twin cards and that only the PM sees both reports; here the PM was one of the two.

The cheap guard I skipped: when a report names a follow-up it intends to file, either let it file the card or tell it not to — never both silently. Nothing was lost this time beyond one issue number.
